formal_statement: ∀ (E : Language Bool) (π : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool) (p : Polynomial ℕ), E ∈ PEqualNP.Library.NP → PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) π → ({x : List Bool | ∃ c : List Bool, c.length ≤ p.eval x.length ∧ π (x, c) ∈ E} : Language Bool) ∈ PEqualNP.Library.NP
plain_statement: If E is in NP and pi is a polynomial-time pairing, then the set of x such that pi(x, c) is in E for some c of polynomial length is in NP. Standard (for example Arora and Barak, Computational Complexity, 2009, chapter 2). Needed by L-meta-016.
title: NP is closed under polynomially bounded existential projection
